title: VoxAngeles
task: archival word-list/elicited production across many languages
annotation_target: audited word/phone transcription and segmentation; word/phone boundaries; durations; F0; F1-F3 trajectories
manual_scope: force-aligned output manually corrected and audited against recordings/field notes; core restricted to audited branch and measurements derived from it
decision_reason: Underlying recordings pre-exist, but VoxAngeles contributes a separately isolatable new human-audited phonetic annotation layer and derived production measurements; unaudited automatic branch excluded.
evidence_summary: Repository separates audited_aligned from unaudited alignments; audited branch has manually corrected phone-level alignments/transcriptions. Public measurement tables preserve phone/word context, boundaries, durations, 10-point F0 and 10-point F1-F3 trajectories.
